Specific_Instance_Per_Administrative_Are.Annotation: Tropical Cyclone Four: It brought gales to Honolulu from August 1 to 4. That surf flooded a warehouse at Honuapo. It also flooded houses in Honuapo and Punaluu Beach, and collapsed flumes at Hutchinson Plantation. On Oahu, Fort Kamehameha was flooded. Lawns at Diamond Head and Kahala were damaged, as were houses on the northern side of Oahu.

Hurricane Seven: After re-curving on October 24 and making landfall near Cabo Corrientes on October 25, the hurricane caused significant damage. In Puerto Vallarta, 270 houses were destroyed while 200 families were left homeless; roads, trees, and telegraph lines were also damaged.
Hurricane Eight: A ship encountered a strong tropical cyclone near Acapulco on November 10 and near Manzanillo on November 11. The cyclone caused heavy rains to coastal areas of Mexico.

Specific_Instance_Per_Administrative_Are.Annotation: Sabadell header: 'In Sabadell, the waters of the local streams and the Ripoll river rose until they reached the homes and industries located within or on the side of the river course. The flood took away the houses it found in its path. The Torre-romeu neighborhood, located in the northeast of the city, on the other side of the Ripoll and built largely on the river bed, was one of the most affected neighborhoods in Sabadell. Can Puigener was another of the neighborhoods that suffered the most from the flood. Also in the neighborhoods of Plana del Pintor or Campoamor the rain affected many houses.'

Ripollet header: 'In the locality of Ripollet, there were 12 victims and some factories and 36 homes were destroyed. Ripollet suffered two more floods on November 4 and 7 of the same year, before having recovered from the first flood.'

Cerdanyola del Vallès header: 'The floods in Cerdanyola del Vallès were not as severe since the Sec river and the Major river, the two rivers that flow through the town, did not receive the same amount as the Riera de les Arenes or the Ripoll river, thus, despite the numerous material losses, no fatalities were recorded. The families that lost their homes, basically in the Montflorit neighborhood, were relocated through the help they received from the City Council.'

For example, storm rows such as for Otto (areas affected: 'Philippines, Taiwan, East China'), Penny ('Philippines, South China'), Rex ('Japan'), Vicki ('Philippines, Japan'), Zeb ('Caroline Islands, Taiwan, Philippines, Japan') and others list locations which – when converted to countries – include the Philippines, Taiwan, China, Japan, and Vietnam. Additional affected locations mentioned in the narrative include South Korea (from Yanni), Cambodia (from Dawn), Laos (from Faith) and Palau (noted in the description for Tropical Depression 01W). Hong Kong is also noted in the narrative describing Tropical Storm Penny.
